manualInspection.finding: All park geometry, Ferris-wheel spokes/supports, entrance towers and banner, grass/cliff boundaries, fences, toolbar and translucent bottom panels match. Auxiliary is a uniform dark grey 64x64 field with the expected lighter rectangle; no main-frame contamination or stale surfaces after auxiliary, recreation or software/Vulkan switches.

limitations: Device identity is the injected persistent owner observed between completed phases plus reviewed production wiring, not interception/counting of every VkDevice creation.
Shutdown verifies weak owner/device expiration and SDL video stopped after Context destruction; no timestamped destructor ordering trace.
UI driver composes real production factory/owner/drawing factory and performs real WSI recreation, but this is a diagnostic capture executable, not ordinary launcher execution.
Auxiliary is a 64x64 synthetic exact pattern, not every offscreen caller or tiled giant output.
This paused 960x640 baseline uses ordinary paint and does not establish native terrain/entity completeness, performance, vsync or TPS gains.
reviewedProductionWiring: Ui.cpp injects the same presentation owner into its drawing factory and configured auxiliary factory; UiParityMain composes those same production types.
DeviceContextOwner retains one context, validates newly recreated surfaces and returns the existing context for auxiliary acquisition.
Context shuts down auxiliary service before UI teardown; service joins worker and clears provider; UiContext releases drawing factory before SDL video quits.
